node.title: KoalaBear Q6 s6 common-five outgoing-fiber pin
node.closure: pinned source-facet vertical-divisor formulas and exact six-label horizontal fibers
node.statement: In every actual graph-free Q=6,s=6 equality-wall source packet, there is a six-label invariant-coordinate set I and a five-label set K contained in I such that, above either point of every source fiber indexed by k in K, the horizontal roots of the whole outgoing factor are exactly the six labels outside I. Every outgoing irreducible component has its horizontal roots there contained in I^c. This is a source-fiber identity, not a component deletion or owner payment.
